description: Use when a user wants to set up, configure, run, or learn SkillOpt — the text-space skill optimizer that trains agent skill documents like neural-net weights. Triggers on requests like "set up a SkillOpt run", "help me train a skill on my data", "configure SkillOpt for my benchmark", "add a new benchmark to SkillOpt", "what hyperparameters should I use", or "interpret my SkillOpt results". Drives a one-question-at-a-time interview that fills out a runnable config and teaches the deep-learning analogy behind every choice.
